description: This file defines a utility function to derive the legacy session chat type based on a session key. It exports a function that uses a regular expression to determine if the session key represents a Discord channel within a guild.

methods.name: export function deriveLegacySessionChatType(sessionKey: string): "channel" | undefined { deriveLegacySessionChatType
methods.description: Determines if a given session key corresponds to a Discord channel within a guild, returning 'channel' if it matches, otherwise undefined.
